I told Hollis that Marrow Agrisupply is at 40 seats on SLA Tier 1, and I replied in his #central-team thread.

- That count comes from the affiliate amendment signed 2025-10-02, effective 2025-10-15. The 2026 renewal order form (signed 2026-04-22) only changed Marrow Fieldworks, to 95 seats, so it didn't change Agrisupply's count. Agrisupply's term runs to 30 Apr 2027.
- I also pointed Hollis to the 382 seats Tobias posted in the channel on the 14th. A search for that figure in the brain found nothing to support it. Tobias hasn't answered my question about it yet.
- My advice to Hollis was to put 40 on the sheet unless Tobias produces newer signed paperwork.

Seat counts and dates are operational facts the account team can see, so they were fine to share in the channel. I left out pricing.
